news.headline: LEOTEK Demonstrates Physical AI for Safer and Smarter Roadways at ITS America 2026 Interlux AI-Powered Traffic Infrastructure Transforms Intersections into Intelligent Sensing Nodes for Real-Time Mobi

paragraphs: LEOTEK sells LED street lights and LED area lights for roadway and outdoor spaces. The company also sells EV charging systems and traffic signals. The RenAI platform connects streetlights, signals, and assets with AI to optimize performance. The Interlux AI traffic signal system combines AI perception, connected vehicle technology, and real-time decision-making.

LEOTEK is headquartered in Silicon Valley and Taipei and provides roadway lighting, traffic signal, and connected infrastructure solutions for cities and transportation agencies worldwide. Since 1992 the company has supported infrastructure projects across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Australasia, and Asia-Pacific.

Lighting from the company is used by cities and transportation authorities across the United States. Roadway and traffic lighting products are designed and manufactured to support compliance with the Build America, Buy America provisions and the Buy American Act.

quote.text: From local streets to major transportation corridors, LEOTEK lighting is trusted by cities and transportation authorities across the United States.
